advance_rationale: The reopen target is repaired at its own stage: prop and torso envelopes now match the measured left outer silhouette, so P5 will not have to clean a wrong structure. A fresh residual sweep of flank, torso, legs and head finds no remaining mass-level mismatch, so structural connections can be rebuilt on this corrected branch.
contract_findings: The rebuilt branch holds P3 vocabulary only: head/hair mass, neck bridge, clothed torso with two cross-contours, pelvis basin, tapered limb masses, one small hanging-pouch mass and the attached-object mass with two cross-contours.
No foot or hand block, joint block, fold, seam, facial feature or shading was reintroduced.
corrections: Rebuilt every P3 mass on the reopened branch.
Re-authored the prop's left contour to the measured, more vertical handguard edge.
Widened the torso-left contour to the observed occupied volume.
Added the thigh pouch as its own small mass so the image-right silhouette is explained.
drawing_findings: Reopen context honoured: the archived P3 and P4 reviews were treated as an abandoned branch and every mass was re-authored rather than resurrected.

left_flank: the corrected prop contour now sits on the measured rifle edge for its whole length, and the corrected torso-left contour now reaches the observed jacket edge instead of underfilling it by about 12 pixels. The registered overlay shows both edges on the subject.
left_flank: the prop-to-garment ownership handoff near canvas y=205 is visible as a crossing of two separate contours, not as one welded line.
torso_pelvis: the widened flank did not overshoot the silhouette on the opposite side; the image-right contour is unchanged and still matches.
pelvis_legs: leg taper and negative space are unchanged and still correct, and the thigh pouch now accounts for the image-right silhouette bulge that the leg mass alone could not explain.
head_neck: hair mass, face plane and neck bridge are unchanged and still connect head to torso.

Fresh residual sweep of the whole rebuilt artifact: it reads as one connected occupied-volume system with no egg torso, box assembly, polygonal pelvis, parallel-rail limbs or underfilled clothed mass.
exemplar_findings: The PASS P3 exemplar decided abstraction level and detail budget only; its bare-body mass vocabulary was again rejected in favour of the clothed-mass policy.
